remarks: HIGHEST and BEST due Tuesday February 17 at 4 pm. Picture-perfect colonial with open floor plan on quiet cul-de-sac. The large foyer welcomes you to this sun-filled home. Cook your favorite meal in the cook's kitchen with newer shaker white cabinets and stainless appliances while friends gather at the island. In winter, dine in the very large dining room with room for all. In the summer, dine al fresco under the stars from the large deck or patio overlooking expansive level yard. After dinner, relax by the firepit or cozy up to the gas fireplace in the large living room. Watch a game or movie in the family room steps off the kitchen. There is a tucked away office up 6 steps off the family room. This bonus area also makes a great exercise room. The mudroom off the garage and laundry room complete the first floor. At night, retire to your primary suite with spa-like bath and walk-in closet. Upstairs there are 3 other bedrooms and an updated bath. This home was made for entertaining and has all the conveniences for everyday living. The rooms are freshly painted, the kitchen and baths are tastefully done, and the windows are all new. Enjoy running, strolling, biking, and socializing in this quiet neighborhood. Convenient to the towns of Wilton and Ridgefield with ample restaurants and stores. Award-winning Wilton schools. All the work has been done. Move in and enjoy. You will love living here.
